# Test fixtures

| File | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reference-a.jpg` | Official White House portrait of President Barack Obama (Pete Souza, 2012) | Public domain — work of the U.S. federal government |
| `event-a.jpg` | White House photo: President Obama addresses a joint session of Congress (2009) | Public domain — work of the U.S. federal government |
| `event-b.jpg` | Crop of a White House photo of Vice President Joe Biden (Blue Room, 2010) | Public domain — work of the U.S. federal government |

The images were taken from the examples of the
[`face_recognition`](https://github.com/ageitgey/face_recognition/tree/master/examples)
project, downscaled to 800 px and re-encoded without metadata.

They are used only to test face detection and matching. Their use does not imply
any endorsement of Blurlist by the people pictured or by the U.S. government.
